correctness.rationale: From normal variation delta H=-Delta f-n csc^2(R) f and E_j(c,...,c)=c^j, reconstruct delta F=delta H/n independent of index k. Independently differentiate phi=N/D at stationary F=c and cancel equal area-variation terms, obtaining delta phi=2c average(delta F)=-2c csc^2(R) average f. Therefore delta(phi/F-F)=(2/n)Delta f+2 csc^2(R)(f-average f). Constants and degree-one harmonics neutral; degree-lambda for degree ell is 2 csc^2(R)(1-ell(ell+n-1)/n), with sharp shape gap 2(n+2)/(n sin^2 R) at ell=2. Independently checked binomial-derivative cancellation through n<=15 and all k; proof analytic for every n>=2, k=0..n-1 and 0<R<pi/2; no nonlinear convergence rate claimed.
